# Beyond Scrumptious

> Handcrafted eggless cakes, desserts, dessert tables and live dessert experiences in Harrow, London.

Beyond Scrumptious is an eggless cake and dessert business based in Harrow, serving celebrations and events across London. All cakes and desserts are gelatine-free and fully customisable — not the whole business is vegan, only eggless. Live dessert stations (Mini Pancake and Croffle) are available for events, cooked fresh in front of guests.

## Products & Services

- [Cakes](https://www.beyondscrumptious.com/cakes): Custom eggless cakes for birthdays, weddings and celebrations — handmade in Harrow, gelatine-free and fully customisable, serving London.
- [Desserts & Dessert Tables](https://www.beyondscrumptious.com/desserts): Eggless, gelatine-free desserts and styled dessert tables for weddings, parties and events — handmade in Harrow, fully customisable, serving London.
- [Live Desserts](https://www.beyondscrumptious.com/live-desserts): Eggless Live Mini Pancake Station and Live Croffle Station for events in London — packages, toppings, sauces and booking process.

## Diwali 2026 (seasonal)

- [Diwali 2026](https://www.beyondscrumptious.com/diwali): Landing page linking to the two Diwali 2026 ranges. Pickup 7th–8th November only, Harrow.
- [Naturally Sweet Cupcakes](https://www.beyondscrumptious.com/diwali/naturally-sweet): No added refined sugar, sweetened with dates. Kulfi, Vanilla & Chocolate.
- [The Diwali Cupcake Collection](https://www.beyondscrumptious.com/diwali/cupcakes): Beautifully decorated, gift-boxed cupcakes in Vanilla, Chocolate, Kulfi & Oreo.
